title: Bound a general crawler to approved URL prefixes
description:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

As a monitor operator, I want a generic crawler constrained to approved source prefixes and run limits, so that I can discover changes without unbounded crawling.

Acceptance behavior (planned, not executable or verified yet):
```gherkin
Feature: Bound a general crawler to approved URL prefixes
  Scenario: Crawl within configured bounds
    Given a Monitor has an approved URL prefix and page, depth, rate and time limits
    When its general crawler runs
    Then it follows only allowed targets within those bounds
    And links and redirects outside the approved scope are not fetched
    And skipped, failed and truncated collection is reported
    And discovered URLs retain source and observation provenance
  Scenario: Validate access before collection
    Given a target has access restrictions or unresolved collection rights
    When the Monitor is prepared for use
    Then its access rules and applicable collection conditions are recorded for validation
    And collection is not represented as authorized merely because a URL is public
```

General crawlers precede bespoke scraper plugins. Custom scraping plugins are deferred. Later design should address robots/site terms, safe redirect handling and protected/internal destinations within the collection boundary.
